description: This file contains partial class definitions related to ADO.NET clustering options, validators, hosting extensions, gateway list providers, and membership table implementations for Orleans. It appears to be part of a larger Orleans clustering and membership management system utilizing ADO.NET.

classes.name: AdoNetClusteringClientOptions
classes.description: Holds configuration options such as connection string and invariant name for client clustering.

classes.name: AdoNetClusteringSiloOptions
classes.description: Holds configuration options such as connection string and invariant name for silo clustering.

classes.name: AdoNetHostingExtensions
classes.description: Contains extension methods to integrate ADO.NET clustering with Orleans hosting builder components.

classes.name: AdoNetGatewayListProvider
classes.description: Provides gateway list management for ADO.NET clustering, implementing IGatewayListProvider.

classes.name: AdoNetClusteringTable
classes.description: Implements the IMembershipTable interface to manage membership data stored via ADO.NET.

methods.name: UseAdoNetClustering
methods.description: Extension methods to configure Orleans client or silo builders to use ADO.NET clustering with options.

methods.name: GetGateways
methods.description: Retrieves the list of gateway URIs.

methods.name: CleanupDefunctSiloEntries
methods.description: Removesold or defunct silo entries from membership table.

methods.name: DeleteMembershipTableEntries
methods.description: Deletes all immigration entries for a given cluster ID.

methods.name: InitializeMembershipTable
methods.description: Initializes membership table, optionally trying to initialize version.

methods.name: InsertRow
methods.description: Attempts to insert a membership entry into the table.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Reads a specific row identified by silo address.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Updates the 'I am alive' status for a membership entry.

methods.name: UpdateRow
methods.description: Updates a membership entry in the table.
